洪福真/洪福瑱/洪天贵福: Hong Tianguifu, the same Young Heavenly King; source uses defective historical variant, normalized for identity continuity
李明成/扬王: Li Mingcheng / King Yang, distinct from Ji Qingyuan’s homophonous title
妾身不分明: uncertainty of his position, a metaphor for Zeng Guoquan’s unresolved appointment
